newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota Brewing loss widens on provisions.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota Brewing loss widens on provisions.

text.p: Minnesota Brewing Co said Wednesday it posted a loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31 after sales orders fell below plan and the company added to its reserves.

The company reported a loss of $1.6 million, or $0.48 a share, compared with a loss of $140,827, or $0.04 a share, one year ago. Sales increased to $5.6 million from $4.7 million, Minnesota Brewing said.
The brewer said it added $150,000 to its reserves to provide for aged inventory and $83,000 to cover a possible loss on contract inventory.
Minnesota Brewing also set a $140,000 provision for an account where a client's new management decided not to honor the previous management's contracts.
Minnesota Brewing's shares were off 1/8 Wednesday at 3-1/4.
